payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the CMIP6 climate models show accuracy in simulating processes relevant to precipitation patterns, despite some studies suggesting underestimation of changes. The agreement between observed data and model predictions supports the authors' conclusion about model accuracy.

claims.text: The relationship between relative spatial precipitation patterns and the forced precipitation trend derived from climate model simulations suggests accuracy of the CMIP6 climate models.
The degree to which model simulations accurately represent responses to forcing remains debated, indicating variability in model performance.
